Introducing Saved Views, available today on every paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, and grouping every time you open a project, this one's for you. Now you can configure a list exactly how you like it—filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by status—and save it for one-click access later.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprint planning, bug triage, client reporting, or whatever your workflow demands. Need your team on the same page? Any saved view can be shared, so teammates see the same filtered, sorted layout without recreating it themselves. That means less time setting up lists and more time acting on them.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates live as new items match your criteria, so shared views stay accurate for everyone who relies on them.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
